## Masca (Village Hag) (CR 7)

This old woman seems pretty ordinary. There’s a gentle smile on her face when she beckons you to come near, but a weird glint in her eye tells you something’s not right.  

**XP** 3,200  
CN Medium monstrous humanoid  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft; Perception +16  


**Defense**


**AC** 20, touch 15, flat-footed 15 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural)  
**hp** 126 (9d10+36)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +10, **Will** +10  
**DR** 10/cold iron and magic; **Immune** charm and compulsion effects; **SR** 18  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** quarterstaff +11/+11/+6/+6 (1d6+3)  
**Special Attacks** knockout gaze (DC 17)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 9th; concentration +12; Intelligence-based)  


At will—disguise self  

3/day—remove disease  

1/day—lesser astral projection, sending  



**Statistics**


**Str** 16, **Dex** 19, **Con** 17, **Int** 17, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +12; **CMD** 26  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), [Improved Two-Weapon Fighting](../../rules/feats/improved-two-weapon-fighting.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Focus (quarterstaff)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Craft +15, Heal +14, Intimidate +14, Perception +16, Sense Motive +13, Spellcraft +12, Use Magic Device +11  
**Languages** Abyssal, Common, Infernal, Sylvan  
**SQ** book of command, change shape (any animal, plant, or object; beast shape II, plant shape I, or object form II)  


**Special Abilities**



**Book of Command (Su)** Each masca carries a book of command, an occult tome that represents the source of her power. The masca can use her book of command as an occultist’s implement for the Divination school as if she were a 9th-level occultist. A masca is considered to possess a mental focus pool of 10 points for this purpose, plus the danger sight, future gaze, object sight, and watchful eye focus powers. A book of command only works for the masca who owns it and disappears if separated from its owner for more than 24 hours or if the hag dies (unless it is left as a legacy). A masca cannot use her spell-like abilities or change shape without her book of command.  

**Knockout Gaze (Su)** Once per combat, the masca can attempt a gaze attack against an opponent to knock them out. If the target fails a Fortitude save, they fall unconscious for 1d4 rounds. A successful Fortitude save reduces this effect to staggered for 1 round. The DC of this save is Intelligence-based.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate plains, fields, and villages  
**Organization** solitary or coven (3 or more)  
**Treasure** standard
